'''Kor Nasirii''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA Kor Nasirii" /> located within the [[Kor Nasirii system/Legends|Kor Nasirii system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and was part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Kor Vosadii system/Legends|Kor Vosadii system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kor Nasirii was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Nasirii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Nasirii" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Nobody's Friend}}</ref> in [[3643 BBY|3643]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place roughly ten to twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] according to ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]]. {{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5365704|text=Question ! :)}} Since the Treaty of Coruscant was signed in [[3653 BBY]] according to ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', this places the events of the game at approximately [[3643 BBY]] to [[3640 BBY]]. This article uses the date of 3643 BBY as an approximate date, but the actual date could be different.</ref> Kor Nasirii housed databases belonging to members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The information contained within the databases was used to blackmail prominent figures throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Nasirii was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the world in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" /> The world was later mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which it was used as a possible location for players to assign their companions on individual quests.<ref name="SWTOR" />
